ncd90686d653.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Polavaram Project?
o: It is designed to irrigate 7.20 lakh acres
Its irrigation area is about 2.91 lakh hectares
Its gross reservoir capacity is 194.6 TMC
Its reservoir size alone explains its irrigation design
ncd90686d653.x: Polavaram irrigates 7.20 lakh acres (2.91 lakh ha) and has a gross capacity of 194.6 TMC, but reservoir size alone does not explain the irrigation design.

ncf4e8a0e8bf.s: Which of the following pairs (AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 section – subject) is correctly matched?
o: Section 30 – Polavaram declared a national project
Section 90 – Polavaram declared a national project
ncf4e8a0e8bf.x: Section 90 declares Polavaram a national project. Section 30 is an old wrong key, Section 89 concerns the KWDT reference and Section 94 covers fiscal and industrial incentives.

nfe5b8b7ec77.s: How many mandals were moved from Khammam to Andhra Pradesh under the Polavaram arrangement?
nfe5b8b7ec77.x: Seven mandals moved: Kukunoor, Velerupadu, VR Puram, Chintoor, Kunavaram, Bhadrachalam (except the temple town) and Burgampadu.

nac4ebcd675a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about sources of irrigation in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Tanks were the largest source of Gross Irrigated Area in 2023-24
Wells and tube wells accounted for about 48% of GIA in 2023-24
Tank irrigation suits the undulating plateau relief and impervious rocks
Canals dominate irrigation in the Godavari-Krishna deltas
nac4ebcd675a.x: Wells and tube wells were the largest source (about 48% of GIA) in 2023-24; tanks accounted for only about 8%.

nb4ba4e87817.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about micro-irrigation in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Andhra Pradesh ranked first nationally in micro-irrigation in 2024-25
SC and ST beneficiaries get only a 55% subsidy
About 75% of the micro-irrigation area is under drip
nb4ba4e87817.x: SC and ST beneficiaries get a 100% micro-irrigation subsidy, not 55%; AP ranked first nationally in 2024-25.

n7b8622a40fc.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the division of institutions under the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014?
o: Schedule X covers 142 institutions, mostly in Hyderabad
Section 53 splits commercial undertakings by location and headquarters assets by population
Schedule IX covers the division of 142 institutions
The Sheela Bhide Committee dealt with the division of institutions and undertakings
n7b8622a40fc.x: Schedule IX covered 91 companies and corporations; the 142 institutions, mostly in Hyderabad, were under Schedule X.

new.s: How much water does the Polavaram Project earmark for Visakhapatnam's drinking and industrial needs?
new.x: Polavaram provides 23.44 TMC for Visakhapatnam and drinking water to 28.5 lakh people in 540 villages.

new.s: The Polavaram dam is built across which river?
new.x: The Polavaram dam is on the Godavari near Polavaram village in Eluru district.

new.s: The Polavaram Project was first contemplated in:
new.x: Polavaram was first contemplated in 1941 as 'Ramapada Sagaram'; the GWDT was set up in 1969 and gave its award in 1980.

new.s: In which year was the Godavari Water Disputes Tribunal set up?
new.x: The GWDT was set up in 1969 and its 1980 award cleared Polavaram.

new.s: Of the 80 TMC of Godavari water diverted to the Krishna via Polavaram, Karnataka's share is:
new.x: The 80 TMC splits as 45 TMC for AP, 21 TMC for Karnataka and 14 TMC for Maharashtra.

new.s: The GWDT cleared the Polavaram Project with a Full Reservoir Level (FRL) of:
new.x: The GWDT cleared Polavaram with an FRL of +150 ft.

new.s: Under Section 90(4) of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014, who obtains the environmental, forest and R&R clearances for Polavaram?
new.x: Section 90(4) makes the Central Government execute the project and obtain environmental, forest and R&R clearances, not AP.

new.s: Which sub-section of Section 90 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 deems the consent of Telangana to have been given?
new.x: Section 90(3) deems Telangana's consent given; 90(2) has the Union take control and 90(4) has the Centre execute the project.

new.s: The Polavaram Ordinance Bill was passed by the Lok Sabha on:
new.x: The AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Ordinance, 2014, the 'Polavaram Ordinance Bill', was passed by the Lok Sabha on 11 July 2014.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Khammam mandals moved to Andhra Pradesh for Polavaram?
o: Kukunoor and Velerupadu were among them
The Bhadrachalam temple town moved to Andhra Pradesh
AP's area rose from 1,60,205 to 1,62,970 sq km
new.x: Bhadrachalam mandal moved to AP except the temple town, which stayed with Telangana.

new.s: What was the older revised cost estimate of the Polavaram Project?
new.x: The older revised cost estimate of Polavaram was ₹55,548 crore.

new.s: How much did the Union Budget 2026-27 allocate for the Polavaram Project?
new.x: The Union Budget 2026-27 gave ₹3,320 crore (storage up to 41.15 m), down from about ₹5,000 crore.

new.s: The Centre's 100% funding of Polavaram from 1 April 2014 does NOT cover which component?
o: Remaining cost of the irrigation works
new.x: The Centre funds 100% of the remaining cost of the irrigation component only, not drinking water or hydel.

new.s: The Polavaram Project Authority was constituted by:
new.x: The PPA was constituted by the Union after the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 to oversee the national project.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Polavaram Project Authority:
1. It routes national-project funding for Polavaram.
2. It mediates inter-State coordination.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The PPA routes national-project funding and mediates inter-State coordination.

new.s: Resettlement and rehabilitation for the Polavaram Project follows which law?
new.x: Polavaram's R&R follows the RFCTLARR Act, 2013.

new.s: Which States have Supreme Court cases pending over submergence by the Polavaram Project?
new.x: Odisha and Chhattisgarh raise submergence concerns, seek protective embankments and have Supreme Court cases pending.

new.s: By August 2026, land acquisition for the Polavaram Project had reached about:
new.x: By August 2026 land acquisition reached 94% and relocation 52%.

new.s: The Polavaram diaphragm wall, rebuilt from January 2025, was completed in:
new.x: The 1,372 m diaphragm wall was rebuilt in 440 days, announced on 2 April 2026.

new.s: What was the overall progress of the Polavaram Project in December 2025?
new.x: Overall progress was 60.8% in December 2025, rising to 77% by August 2026.

new.s: Which body cleared the safety of the Polavaram spillway in April 2026?
new.x: The Central Water Commission cleared spillway safety in April 2026 after the foreign expert panel's reviews.

new.s: Which district had the largest irrigated area in Andhra Pradesh in 2023-24?
new.x: Eluru (2.39 lakh ha) led, followed by Ananthapuramu and Nandyal.

new.s: Which source accounted for about 40% of Andhra Pradesh's Gross Irrigated Area in 2023-24 and ranked second?
new.x: Canals (13.24 lakh ha, about 40%) were second to wells and tube wells (about 48%).

new.s: Under the national classification by culturable command area, a minor irrigation project covers up to:
new.x: Nationally, minor projects cover up to 2,000 ha CCA, medium 2,000-10,000 ha; AP's own minor limit is 5,000 acres ayacut.

new.s: Which of the following is a gravity irrigation project?
new.x: Veligonda draws Krishna water by gravity; Handri-Neeva and Pattiseema are lift schemes and Prakasam is a barrage.

new.s: The Somasila project, part of the Telugu Ganga chain, is on which river?
new.x: Somasila is on the Pennar and forms part of the Telugu Ganga chain.

new.s: The Prakasam Barrage replaced an anicut built in the 1850s by:
new.x: The Prakasam Barrage, begun in 1954, replaced Cotton's 1850s anicut on the Krishna.

new.s: How many acres does the Handri-Neeva Sujala Sravanthi project aim to irrigate?
new.x: HNSS uses 40 TMC to irrigate 6.025 lakh acres in Rayalaseema.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Pattiseema scheme:
1. It is a gravity irrigation scheme.
2. It is temporary until Polavaram's gravity flow starts.
3. It uses 24 pumps.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Pattiseema is a temporary lift scheme with 24 pumps, not a gravity scheme.

new.s: Pattiseema is known as the first link between which two rivers?
new.x: Pattiseema lifts Godavari water to the Krishna at Prakasam Barrage, the first Godavari-Krishna link.

new.s: The proposed Polavaram-Banakacherla link plans to carry how much Godavari water?
new.x: The proposed link would carry 200 TMC via the Bollapalli reservoir and Banakacherla regulator.

new.s: The Polavaram-Banakacherla link proposes to carry Godavari water to which basin?
new.x: The link would take Godavari water via the Krishna to the Penna basin in Rayalaseema.

new.s: Jalayagnam aimed to bring how much area under irrigation?
new.x: Jalayagnam aimed to irrigate 1 crore acres and stabilise 21 lakh acres through 52 major and medium projects.

new.s: Which of the following Jalayagnam projects was NOT among those still unfinished in 2025-26?
new.x: Veligonda, HNSS and GNSS remained unfinished in 2025-26; Prakasam Barrage dates from the First-Second Plan.

new.s: The Telugu Ganga project belongs to which Plan period?
new.x: Telugu Ganga (1983) belongs to the Sixth Plan; Srisailam was Third and Jalayagnam Tenth.

new.s: The Neeru-Chettu programme was launched on:
new.x: Neeru-Chettu was launched on 2 October 2014; Neeru-Meeru dates from 2000.

new.s: Since inception, what share of the micro-irrigation area under APMIP is under sprinkler?
new.x: APMIP coverage is 75% drip and 25% sprinkler.

new.s: The APFAMGS farmer-managed groundwater initiative was supported by:
new.x: APFAMGS, where farmers prepare crop-water budgets and limit pumping, was FAO-supported.

new.s: Under APFAMGS, farmers themselves collect data on:
new.x: APFAMGS farmers collect rainfall and well data to prepare crop-water budgets.

new.s: The Tungabhadra Board releases water to which Telangana scheme?
new.x: The Tungabhadra Board serves AP's HLC and LLC and Telangana's Rajolibanda Diversion Scheme.

new.s: The first Krishna Water Disputes Tribunal (KWDT-I) was headed by:
new.x: KWDT-I under Bachawat (1969, award 1976) allocated 811 TMC to combined AP; KWDT-II was under Brijesh Kumar.

new.s: KWDT-I distributed 2,130 TMC of Krishna water at what dependability?
new.x: KWDT-I worked at 75% dependability; KWDT-II assessed 2,293 TMC at 65%.

new.s: Which of the following pairs (project – river) is correctly matched?
new.x: Nagarjuna Sagar is on the Krishna; Hirakud is on the Mahanadi, Damodar Valley on the Damodar and Tungabhadra on the Tungabhadra.

new.s: After bifurcation, Genome Valley and the Hyderabad pharma belt went to:
new.x: Genome Valley and its R&D went to Telangana; AP kept only a bulk-drug base at Visakhapatnam.

new.s: The 'about 10.5% of GSDP' figure for residual Andhra Pradesh just after bifurcation refers to:
new.x: The 10.5% is manufacturing only, not the whole industry sector, which also adds mining, construction and utilities.

new.s: In 2025-26 GVA at current prices, industry's share in Andhra Pradesh was about:
new.x: In 2025-26, services were 43%, agriculture 33% and industry 24%; manufacturing alone was 10.84%.

new.s: Under Section 5 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014, Hyderabad was the common capital till:
new.x: Section 5 made Hyderabad the common capital for up to 10 years, till 2024.

new.s: After bifurcation, the AP government moved from Hyderabad to:
new.x: The government moved to Velagapudi (Amaravati); APSWAN HQ moved to the Velagapudi Secretariat in 2017.

new.s: Under Section 94, new industrial units in the backward districts get an additional depreciation of:
new.x: New units get 15% additional depreciation and a 15% investment allowance.

new.s: Which sub-section of Section 94 of the AP Reorganisation Act provides for tax incentives?
new.x: Section 94(1) covers fiscal measures including tax incentives; 94(2) covers backward-area infrastructure.

new.s: Sri City, a multi-product SEZ, lies in which district?
new.x: Sri City is a multi-product SEZ in Tirupati district.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's Industrial Development Policy 4.0 covers the period:
new.x: Industrial Development Policy 4.0 covers 2024-29.

new.s: Which of the following was NOT a cause of the investment slowdown in Andhra Pradesh after 2014?
new.x: The slowdown came from capital uncertainty, no ready administrative set-up and agitations; AP has a long coastline.

new.s: In the 2015 BRAP ease of doing business ranking, Andhra Pradesh ranked:
new.x: In 2015 AP ranked 2nd, behind Gujarat.

new.s: In BRAP 2019, which State ranked first?
new.x: AP ranked first in BRAP 2019, with UP second and Telangana third.

new.s: In BRAP 2016, Andhra Pradesh ranked first jointly with:
new.x: In 2016 AP and Telangana jointly ranked first.
